name: Miner's Landing
desc:
Miner's Landing is the [Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union)'s base of operations in the East, situated on a large island that houses a volcano.

It contains a Voidzone, the [Saramaed Summit](location:saramaed_summit). It also contains a dungeon, the [Saramaed Hollow](location:saramaed_hollow), which is the main way of progression for people with the Ignition Delver origin (who subsequently spawn here as well.)
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is Peregrine by Naktigonis so far. Its own theme song has been confirmed to be released.
-   Miner's Landing has a more industrial focus than the other bases such as [Etris](location:etris) and [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel).
-   Various Union Hooks can be found throughout Miner's Landing.
-   Players with the Ignition Delver Origin spawn here by default.
